_comment: Crawlers the ai.robots.txt snapshot does not list (search engines, link previewers, one fictional operator). Same field names as robots.json. LocalSearchBot is invented for this lab: a small search engine that publishes neither IP ranges nor a reverse-DNS suffix.

Googlebot.description: Google Search crawler. Verified by forward-confirmed reverse DNS (*.googlebot.com, *.google.com) or the published common-crawlers.json ranges.

bingbot.description: Bing crawler. Verified by reverse DNS (*.search.msn.com).

DuckDuckBot.description: Verified against DuckDuckGo's published IP list.

Applebot.description: Applebot-Extended is the separate robots.txt token for AI training opt-out.

Slackbot-LinkExpanding.description: User-triggered fetch of a single page; does not crawl.

facebookexternalhit.description: May bypass robots.txt for integrity checks (Meta docs).

LocalSearchBot.description: A small regional search engine invented for this lab. Publishes no IP ranges and no reverse-DNS suffix, so it can be identified but never verified.
